name: Netorase Phone
source:
Netorase Phone is an adult visual novel about exploring your sexual fantasies with your girlfriend.

The story is told through text messages and pictures, by talking with the various characters.

[From [url=https://lestag.itch.io/netorase-phone]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Netorase Phone》是一部關於情侶一同探索性幻想的成人視覺小說。

你會透過簡訊和照片與不同角色交談，逐步瞭解這段故事。

［摘自[url=https://lestag.itch.io/netorase-phone]itch.io[/url]］
